CANONICAL_NAME.value: python-control -- the Python Control Systems Library

VERSION.value: github.com/python-control/python-control main as of 2026-09-12 (commit in hashes)

value.lineage: python-control (2010-, Murray et al., Caltech): LTI systems, state-space and transfer functions, LQR/LQE optimal control, pole placement, frequency response; the open reference implementing the classical/modern control toolbox in Python

HUMAN_PROBLEM.value: model-based optimal control design (LQR and friends)

value.built_to: design and simulate controllers for linear dynamical systems -- compute an optimal state-feedback gain (LQR) that trades control effort against state error, and simulate the resulting closed loop
value.pressure: a multivariable plant with coupled states where hand-tuning fails; the controller must stabilise and optimise a quadratic cost
value.success_means: the closed-loop system is stable and drives the state to the target with the intended effort/error trade-off

value.pressure: coupled multivariable dynamics, control-effort limits, the effort-vs-error trade-off
value.failure_condition: an unstable or badly-tuned gain lets the state diverge; in a physical plant that is a crash

ANCESTRY.value: python-control (2010-, Murray et al., Caltech): LTI systems, state-space and transfer functions, LQR/LQE optimal control, pole placement, frequency response; the open reference implementing the classical/modern control toolbox in Python
